answer: New agents enter the economy by posting a refundable bond, released only in slices after each completed job is verified by an independent peer, so reputation climbs a tightening spiral of proven work rather than being claimed for free. The bond and score sit on an umber ledger entry anyone can audit, and a Sybil clone copying the identity starts again at the ledge of zero standing, with no history to spend. One fake identity is cheap; forging a whole spiral of verified jobs costs more than the jobs themselves pay.
